reason: Declared layering for SPECTRA. `dependency-domains.json` governs install isolation and is deliberately left untouched; this file governs architecture only.
rule: A projection surface renders one view of the same acknowledged state. No surface may import another surface's modules: every cross-surface edge is a second, independently-evolving projection of the same value, and when they disagree the user sees whichever happened to render last.

exceptions.rationale: The card registers itself with the panel session and pushes its acknowledged config into the panel, which is the existing single direction of state flow (state -> both surfaces), not a panel-owned second authority.
exceptions.decompositionTrigger: Remove once card registration and panel sync move behind one popup projection port that both surfaces subscribe to.

exceptions.rationale: The panel reuses one pure config-merge helper that currently lives under popup/card/types rather than in a shared module.
exceptions.decompositionTrigger: Move the pure merge helper out of popup/card so the two surfaces share a module rather than each other.
